rv.q: The timeless music and messages of Ain’t Too Proud

The touring production of the 2019. Broadway musical, based on the autobiography of Temptations founding member Otis Williams and currently playing at the National Theatre, strikes the perfect balance.
This delightful musical transported us through the wonderful story of historical music group The Temptations.
Director Des McAnuff and choreographer Sergio Trujillo have injected more light and fun into their engaging production.

It’s a fast-paced show, covering a significant amount of time and many different people.
Regardless, Ain't Too Proud delivers the good stuff.

cn.t: Critics find this Temptations musical delivers powerhouse vocals and smooth choreography, but struggles with depth. The beloved hits shine through, though the bio-jukebox format leans toward mythmaking over substance.
